zh-CN.name: 自建 Tool 与 MCP
zh-CN.summary: 编写、登记和验证可复用工具与 MCP 服务
zh-CN.description: 在用户需要自主编写、封装或修改自定义 Tool、MCP Server 或设备协议接入能力时使用。复用现有执行与审批合同；依赖真实可用的运行时、驱动/库及获准设备或服务，第三方许可、部署和费用按所选依赖确认，缺条件时报告。

en-US.name: Self-authored Tools and MCP
en-US.summary: Build, register and verify reusable tools and MCP services
en-US.description: Use when the user needs to build, package or modify a custom Tool, MCP Server or device-protocol integration. Reuse existing execution and approval contracts. Requires actual runtimes, drivers/libraries and authorized devices/services; third-party licenses, deployment and costs depend on the chosen dependencies. Report missing prerequisites.
